sentences.text:
The petitioner is the accused in Crime No.1006/2023 of Konni Police Station, Pathanamthitta alleging commission of offences punishable under Sections 450 and 376 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4, 3 (a), 11 (iv), 11 (vi) of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 (the POCSO Act).
2.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The allegation against the petitioner is that the petitioner maintained a relationship with the minor victim and made phone calls and text messages to her and had taken the victim to different places.
On 28-02- 2023 at about 11 p.m the petitioner allegedly trespassed into the house of the minor girl.
At about 1 a.m on 01-03-2023 the petitioner allegedly committed rape on the minor victim.
3. The learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that the petitioner is a 21 year old boy who is in a romantic relationship with the minor victim who is aged aged 17.
It is submitted that the petitioner and the victim are proposing to get married immediately after the victim attains the age of majority.
It is submitted that the petitioner has been in custody from 15-09-2023.
It is submitted that investigation has been completed and final report has been filed in Crime No.1006/2023.
It is submitted that in such circumstances continued detention of the petitioner is not necessary.
4. The learned Public Prosecutor refers to the circumstances appearing against the petitioner.

It is submitted that the argument that the petitioner and the minor victim were in a relationship cannot be accepted as the victim is a minor and she could not have validly given consent for sexual relationship.
It is submitted that in such circumstances the petitioner is not entitled to bail.

5. Having heard the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor,
I am of the view that the petitioner can be granted bail.
The petitioner is aged only 21.
No criminal antecedents are reported against the petitioner.
Though the victim is a minor I cannot rule out the possibility of the fact that the petitioner and the minor victim were in a romantic relationship.
According to the petitioner the petitioner and the minor victim intend to get married once the victim attains the age of majority.
Since the final report has been filed, continued detention of the petitioner is not necessary for the purpose of any investigation.
Accordingly this bail application is allowed.

The petitioner shall be released on bail, subject to the following conditions:-
(i) The petitioner shall execute bond for a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees fifty thousand only) with two solvent sureties each for the like sum to the satisfaction of the jurisdictional Court;

(iii) The petitioner shall not attempt to interfere with the investigation, influence or intimidate the victim or any witness in Crime No.1006/2023 of Konni Police Station,
Pathanamthitta;
(iv) The petitioner shall not involve in any other crime while on bail.

If any of the aforesaid conditions are violated, the investigating officer in Crime No.1006/2023 of Konni Police Station, Pathanamthitta may file an application before the jurisdictional Court for cancellation of bail.

Sd/-
GOPINATH P. JUDGE AMG APPENDIX OF BAIL APPL. 10254/2023 PETITIONER ANNEXURES Annexure 1 THE TRUE COPY OF THE FIR DATED 14.09.23 IN CRIME NO.
